[element-citation-alternatives]
=== `<citation-alternatives>` Citation Alternatives

Holds alternative versions of a single citation, for example, the same citation in multiple languages or a single citation tagged as both a <<element-mixed-citation,`<mixed-citation>`>>, complete with punctuation and spacing preserved, and as an <<element-element-citation,`<element-citation>`>>, with punctuation and spacing removed.

* <<attribute-xml-base,`@xml:base`>>
